designPhilosophy: Dual-bay 96-well SBS microplate indexer + MGN9H linear rail XY gantry + T8 leadscrew pipette plunger escapement
summary: Entry-level benchtop 96-well plate pipetting robots and automated serial-dilution workstations cost $590–$3,500+. This DIY open-labware alternative pairs 8 precision PETG/PLA+ structural gantry & compliant pipette clamp STLs with MGN9H linear rails, NEMA17 stepper motors, a T8 anti-backlash leadscrew, and a 3-axis ESP32 GRBL controller for $68.50 total.
assemblyNotes: Print PRT-01 (96-Well Indexing Deck) and PRT-02/03 (Gantry Uprights) in PETG with 4 perimeters and 35% cubic infill for dimensional stability.
MGN9H rail mounting ledges include a 0.15mm reference shoulder to guarantee X/Y orthogonality without dial-indicator tramming.
Packs across 2 build plates on a Bambu Lab A1 (256×256mm bed): Plate 1 holds the 96-well deck + electronics housing + small carriages; Plate 2 holds the left/right portal uprights and Z-cradle.

parts.name: Dual-Bay SBS 96-Well Microplate Indexing Deck
parts.description: Rigid base plate featuring two ANSI/SLAS 127.76×85.48mm 96-well plate nests and tip waste chute.
parts.roleInAssembly: Establishes the kinematic datum for both 96-well microplates and anchors the gantry uprights.

parts.name: Standard SBS 96-Well Flat-Bottom Microplates (2×) & 200µL Tip Rack
parts.description: Two standard 96-well (8×12 matrix, 9.0mm pitch) assay plates and universal 200µL tips.
parts.roleInAssembly: Snaps into the PRT-01 deck nests for source reagent and target serial dilution.

parts.name: Left Y-Axis Portal Upright & NEMA17 Motor Mount
parts.description: Gusseted left portal column housing the X-axis NEMA17 stepper motor and optical home switch.
parts.roleInAssembly: Supports the left end of the MGN9H X-axis bridge rail and drives the GT2 timing belt.

parts.name: Right Y-Axis Portal Upright & Idler Pulley Tower
parts.description: Right portal column with integrated M3 screw GT2 belt tensioner and MGN9H rail seat.
parts.roleInAssembly: Supports the right end of the X-axis rail and tensions the GT2 belt loop.

parts.name: MGN9H 250mm Miniature Stainless Linear Guide Rails + Blocks (×2)
parts.description: Pair of 250mm MGN9 linear rails with preloaded recirculating-ball MGN9H carriage blocks.
parts.roleInAssembly: Guides zero-play X/Y motion across the 96-well plate grid.

parts.name: GT2 6mm Fiberglass Timing Belt (2m) + 20T 5mm Bore Pulleys & Idlers
parts.description: 2m roll of 2mm-pitch GT2 belt with two 20-tooth motor pulleys and two 20T toothed idlers.
parts.roleInAssembly: Transmits synchronous motion from the NEMA17 steppers to the X/Y carriages.

parts.name: NEMA 17 Bipolar Stepper Motors 1.8° 42×34mm (3-Pack)
parts.description: Three 1.8° 200-step/rev NEMA17 bipolar stepper motors for X-carriage, Y-deck, and Z-plunger.
parts.roleInAssembly: Drives X/Y gantry positioning and T8 leadscrew pipette dispensing.

parts.name: MGN9H Linear Rail X-Axis Pipette Shuttle Carriage
parts.description: Precision shuttle block that bolts to the MGN9H bearing block with self-locking GT2 belt teeth.
parts.roleInAssembly: Carries the Z-axis pipette assembly along the X-axis linear rail.

parts.name: Compliant Z-Axis Micropipette Barrel Clamp
parts.description: Quick-release flexure cradle that holds standard 10–200µL single or 8-channel lab micropipettes.
parts.roleInAssembly: Mounts the micropipette vertically to the X-carriage and guides the T8 plunger nut.

parts.name: T8×2mm Pitch Stainless Leadscrew (200mm) + Anti-Backlash Brass Nut
parts.description: Single-start Tr8×2mm leadscrew with spring-loaded anti-backlash brass nut and 5×8mm coupler.
parts.roleInAssembly: Translates stepper microsteps into 0.0006mm/microstep linear plunger displacement.

parts.name: T8 Leadscrew Pipette Plunger Actuation Escapement
parts.description: Anti-rotation fork mounted on the T8 brass nut that depresses the micropipette thumb plunger.
parts.roleInAssembly: Converts NEMA17 T8 leadscrew rotation into sub-microliter plunger strokes.

parts.name: Snap-Fit Disposable Tip Stripping Fork
parts.description: Bifurcated stripping collar that ejects used 200µL pipette tips into the deck waste chute.
parts.roleInAssembly: Strips disposable tips cleanly at the top of the Z-travel stroke.

parts.name: Optical / Micro Limit Switch Homing Sensors with Cables (3-Pack)
parts.description: Three X/Y/Z zero-reference homing switches with 3-pin XH2.54 harnesses.
parts.roleInAssembly: Establishes repeatable 0.05mm home coordinates before indexing into Well A1.

parts.name: M3 Stainless Socket Head Cap Screws & Brass Heat-Set Insert Kit
parts.description: M3×8mm, M3×12mm, and M3×16mm socket cap screws for MGN9H rails and NEMA17 motor mounts.
parts.roleInAssembly: Fastens MGN9H rails, NEMA17 motors, and T8 brass nut to the 3D-printed frame.

parts.name: Vented GRBL / ESP32 3-Axis Stepper Electronics Housing
parts.description: Rear-mounted electronics bay with cooling louvers and M3 standoffs for the ESP32 GRBL board.
parts.roleInAssembly: Encloses and cools the 3-axis ESP32 CNC board and TMC2209 stepper drivers.

parts.name: ESP32 GRBL 3-Axis CNC Controller Board + 3× TMC2209 Silent Drivers
parts.description: Wi-Fi/USB-C 3-axis FluidNC/GRBL-ESP32 motion controller with 256-microstep TMC2209 drivers.
parts.roleInAssembly: Executes G-code pipetting protocols over USB-C or browser Wi-Fi UI.

parts.name: 12V 3A 36W Regulated DC Power Supply Adapter (5.5×2.1mm)
parts.description: 100–240V AC to 12V 3A DC power brick supplying the three NEMA17 stepper drivers.
parts.roleInAssembly: Powers the ESP32 GRBL controller board and stepper motors.
